reviewNotes: Rebates verified on MBS Online 2026-09-03, all 'Schedule Fee Updated 01-Jul-2026' (85% benefit): general psychologist item 80110 $101.55; clinical psychologist item 80010 $149.05; mental health social worker item 80135 $89.50; mental health occupational therapist item 80160 $89.50; psychiatrist first appointment item 296 (45+ min, new or returning patient) $268.90; psychiatrist follow-up item 302 (15-30 min) $89.30. Longer follow-ups (items 304/306) rebate more; the calculator uses 302 so it doesn't understate costs.

Earlier versions labelled the psychiatrist initial rebate as item 291. That item is the one-off assessment-and-management-plan attendance ($467.45 from 1 Jul 2026), not a normal first appointment. Item 296 is the right one.
Counsellors and psychotherapists have no Medicare rebate (not in the Better Access scheme); rebate 0 and setup null so the GP question and 'one-off to get started' block are hidden.

chips = the quick-pick fee buttons (Lower / Typical / Higher). General psychologist 200/250/330 is sourced: Help Link 2026 network data across 371 psychologists (median $245, average $237, range $0-$360) and the APS recommended 2026-27 rate $330, verified 2026-09-03.
